source_documents.title: A PET-activated photosensitizer based on ROS-sensitive Trolox for tumor microenvironment-responsive imaging and therapy

reference_evidence_units.quote: In normal cells, both fluorescence and photodynamic therapy effects are effectively quenched via photoinduced electron transfer (PET).
reference_evidence_units.subject: EtNBS-2C-Tro, EtNBSe-2C-Tro
reference_evidence_units.statement: Trolox quenches emission and photosensitization by PET.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Density functional theory (DFT) calculations revealed that upon excitation, electron transfer from the Trolox moiety to the EtNBS unit enables the occurrence of PET
reference_evidence_units.subject: EtNBS-nC-Tro
reference_evidence_units.statement: Trolox HOMO above the dye HOMO: reductive PET.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Meanwhile, fluorescence and transient absorption spectra verified the dramatic inhibition of both emission and triplet state formation.
reference_evidence_units.subject: conjugates
reference_evidence_units.statement: Both singlet emission and triplet formation are suppressed.

reference_evidence_units.quote: For instance, the Ff of EtNBS-nC-Tro decreased from 7.6% to 0.27% as the linker chain length was gradually shortened, a trend also observed for EtNBSe-nC-Tro.
reference_evidence_units.subject: EtNBS-nC-Tro, EtNBSe-nC-Tro
reference_evidence_units.statement: Shorter linker, stronger quenching (2C is the most quenched).

reference_evidence_units.quote: The fluorescent quantum yields (Ff) for EtNBS and EtNBSe were 21% and 3%, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: parent dyes
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reference quantum yields of the unconjugated dyes.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Specifically, the FT of EtNBSe-2C-Tro was found to be only 4.7% of EtNBSe.
reference_evidence_units.subject: EtNBSe-2C-Tro vs EtNBSe
reference_evidence_units.statement: Triplet yield of the conjugate is 4.7% of the parent.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This significant difference of FT between EtNBSe and EtNBSe-2C-Tro demonstrates that PET quenches the triplet state of EtNBSe-2C-Tro, leading to a decrease in 1O2 generation.
reference_evidence_units.subject: EtNBSe-2C-Tro

reference_evidence_units.quote: Upon oxidation of the Trolox chromanol ring by ROS, the HOMO level of Trolox drops below that of EtNBS, thereby inhibiting the PET process and enabling selective fluorescence response and PDT.
reference_evidence_units.subject: conjugates + ROS
reference_evidence_units.statement: Oxidised Trolox can no longer donate an electron.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Trolox-to-dye PET (DFT) quenches emission; the 2C linker gives the strongest quenching versus the parent dye (21%).

contrast_group.varied_factor: chalcogen of the benzo[a]phenochalcogenazinium dye (S vs Se)
contrast_group.paper_difference: Both conjugates are PET-quenched; the Se dye carries a large triplet yield (parent singlet-oxygen yield 78% vs 3% for S) whose formation PET also suppresses.
